en: Qal’at al-Bahrain, nearby, was the seat of ancient Dilmun and is a UNESCO site.
The Bahrain World Trade Center has three wind turbines between its two towers.
it: Qal’at al-Bahrain, qui vicino, fu sede dell’antica Dilmun ed è un sito UNESCO.
Il Bahrain World Trade Center ha tre turbine eoliche tra le sue due torri.
